title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on Numbers 22: Balak sends for Balaam, and Balaam's donkey sees Yahweh's angel standing in the way.

questions.text: What did Moab say this multitude of Israel would do to everything around them?
questions.explanation: Moab told the elders of Midian that the multitude would lick up all that was around them, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.

answers.text: Burn it up like stubble in the field
Eat it up like a swarm of locusts
Scatter it like chaff before the wind
Lick it up as the ox licks up the grass

questions.text: Whom did Balak son of Zippor send messengers to, at Pethor by the River?
questions.explanation: Balak sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to call him.

answers.text: The elders of Midian
Balaam the son of Beor
Sihon king of the Amorites
Og king of Bashan

questions.text: Why did God tell Balaam not to curse the people?
questions.explanation: God said to Balaam, "You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed."

answers.text: Because they are too many to count
Because Balak was lying
Because they are blessed
Because the time had not yet come

questions.text: What did Balaam say he could not do, even for a house full of silver and gold?
questions.explanation: Balaam said that even for Balak's house full of silver and gold he could not go beyond the word of Yahweh his God, to do less or more.

answers.text: Go beyond the word of Yahweh his God
Leave his own land by the River
Travel through the night to Moab
Accept gifts from the elders of Midian

questions.text: What did the donkey see standing in the way?
questions.explanation: The donkey saw Yahweh's angel standing in the way with his sword drawn in his hand, and turned out of the path into the field.

answers.text: A lion crouching in the road
A band of Israelite soldiers
Yahweh's angel with a drawn sword
A pillar of fire in the field

questions.text: What happened when the donkey thrust herself against the wall in the narrow path between the vineyards?
questions.explanation: The donkey thrust herself to the wall and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall, and he struck her again.

answers.text: The wall fell down on top of them
One of Balaam's two servants was hurt
She broke her leg and could not walk
She crushed Balaam's foot against the wall

questions.text: What did the donkey ask Balaam when Yahweh opened her mouth?
questions.explanation: She said, "What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?"

answers.text: "What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?"
"Why do you not see the angel standing before us?"
"Where are you taking me so early in the morning?"
"Why do you go with these princes to curse Israel?"

questions.text: What did Balaam wish he had in his hand when he answered the donkey?
questions.explanation: Balaam said, "Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you."

answers.text: A staff
A sword
A rope
A spear

questions.text: What did Yahweh's angel say he would have done if the donkey had not turned away?
questions.explanation: The angel said that unless she had turned away, he would surely have killed Balaam and saved her alive.

answers.text: Taken Balaam back to Pethor
Blinded both Balaam and the donkey
Killed Balaam and saved the donkey alive
Let Balaam go on to curse Israel

questions.text: Where did Balak bring Balaam in the morning, so that he saw part of the people?
questions.explanation: In the morning Balak took Balaam and brought him up into the high places of Baal, and he saw from there part of the people.

answers.text: The top of Peor
The high places of Baal
The field of Zophim
The plains of Moab by the Jordan
